contentText: Russia accused Ukraine of launching a drone attack on Vladimir Putin's residence, vowing to respond and warning it would toughen its position on a possible peace deal. Vladimir Putin also told Russian army commanders to press on with their offensive in Zaporizhzhia. Ukraine has denied the accusations and said the reports would undermine the peace process, with current talks stuck over several issues, especially territorial.
